text: Claude ko ab apna khud ka WhatsApp number mil sakta hai. Aur zyada tar business owners ko ye pata hi nahi. Socho, raat ke do baje customer poochta hai: Friday ko slot hai? Aur turant jawab aata hai, free slots ke saath, aur booking ho jaati hai. Ye hota hai ek free tool se. Naam hai Kapso. Ye Claude ko WhatsApp ke official API se jodta hai. Free plan mein mahine ke twothousand messages. Setup sirf teen step ka hai. Step one Kapso pe sign up karo, aur apna business number link karo. Step two Ek command se Kapso ki WhatsApp skills Claude Code mein daal do. Step three Claude ko bolo: mere business ke liye WhatsApp agent banao jo bookings sambhale. Baaki code Claude khud likhta hai. Aur agent aapke number pe chaubees ghante chalta hai. Bas ek rule yaad rakho: customer ki permission pehle. Poora setup aur ready prompt maine ek free guide mein daal diya hai. Chahiye to follow karo aur comment karo AGENT. Guide seedha aapke DM mein.
